American Clothing Restoration provides professional textile restoration for clothing and fabric-based belongings affected by property damage.

Professional Claims Workflow

How Our Partnership Works

Six clear steps, from the first referral through the return of belongings. Select a step to see the details.

  1. 01Submit a Claim or Referral

    Contact ACR at any time with the property loss details and the names of the adjuster or restoration contractor. ACR coordinates the next steps with the appropriate parties.

  2. 02Damage Assessment

    The affected clothing, garments, and textiles are reviewed by material, condition, damage type, and restoration potential.

  3. 03Inventory & Estimate

    ACR prepares itemized inventories, supporting photographs, and written restoration estimates, including Xactimate-based assignments or estimates.

  4. 04Pickup & Restoration

    ACR provides free pickup, professional textile restoration, off-site storage, and emergency turnaround for essential clothing when needed.

  5. 05Communication & Coordination

    ACR works with insurance adjusters and restoration contractors as the work progresses and coordinates the authorized scope and return arrangements.

  6. 06Delivery & Billing

    Restored belongings are returned on a scheduled basis. ACR provides closeout details and bills insurance carriers directly when authorized. Coverage and payment depend on the applicable policy and claim approval.

Have a new assignment? Contact ACR to coordinate the next steps.
